title: Delaware Art Museum

services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: Make your next event extraordinary. The Delaware Art Museum is a modern venue in a historic Wilmington setting, complete with engaging art exhibits. Imagine endless possibilities. Dine, dance, and mingle with your guests in Fusco Hall. The high ceilings and dramatic arched windows create an elegant space for your reception or seated dinner. Make a grand entrance on our contemporary staircase in East Court, perfect for stylish and intimate gatherings. Or watch the sun set during happy hour on North Terrace, overlooking our serene Sculpture Garden. services.name: Plan Your Tour
services.desc: The Delaware Art Museum offers private tours for groups of 10-60, featuring galleries devoted to American Illustration, Early American Art, Pre-Raphaelite Art, and Contemporary Art, as well as thoughtfully curated special exhibitions. The Museum also offers public tours of select special exhibitions on Saturdays throughout the year. Enhance your visit with our 9-acre sculpture garden, Museum Store, boutique café, and group catering options. DelArt is close to both city of Wilmington attractions and Brandywine Valley museums and gardens. Free on-site parking accommodates tour buses and personal vehicles, and accessible restrooms.
